evidence.trustReason: The renamed T1.2 path is unloadable after a committed rename, while the newer whole-spec slice folds T1.1 to trusted. Real TaskCommand.run on the T1.3 folder records a job start for [gone, trusted], skips older conflicting and unloadable slices, and skips a newer T1.4 slice without T1.1. With the unloadable slice newer than the deciding trusted slice, both direct and intervening orders return exactly one plain refusal line naming the old path and the required whole-spec remedy; no job or fact starts. The direct folderTrust checks agree.
